items.headline: Teddy and Trell target returns as Round 26 late mail lands
items.detail: James Tedesco and Latrell Mitchell are both in line to return for their clubs in the final round of the regular season, according to the latest NRL team news.

items.headline: Hughes boost for Bellamy as Storm prepare to face the Broncos
items.detail: Melbourne are set to welcome back playmaker Jahrome Hughes for their Round 26 clash with Brisbane at Suncorp Stadium.

items.headline: Bulldogs back Galvin to keep the dream alive in the run home
items.detail: Canterbury have thrown their support behind young playmaker Lachlan Galvin as they push for a finals berth.

items.headline: Eagles star Harley Reid learns his fate at the AFL Tribunal
items.detail: West Coast's Harley Reid was fighting a two-match ban at the AFL Tribunal over an incident in the round 24 clash with Hawthorn.

items.headline: Bombers open to 'aggressively' pursuing Toby Greene as Giants star meets Cats
items.detail: New Essendon coach Mark McVeigh says the club wants to attract more senior players, with GWS captain Toby Greene set to meet Geelong.

items.headline: Daicos' stunning season could end with the Magpies' captaincy nod
items.detail: Superstar Nick Daicos is tracking to become Collingwood's full-time captain as soon as next season after another award-laden campaign.

items.headline: Segner out of the South Africa tour as New Zealand injuries pile up
items.detail: Flanker Anton Segner is the latest All Black to head home injured ahead of the tour of South Africa.

items.headline: All Blacks need a late surge to maul the Lions in South Africa
items.detail: New Zealand required a late rally to overcome the British and Irish Lions in their tour match in South Africa.

items.headline: Erasmus wants the Boks to turn anger and hurt on the All Blacks
items.detail: South Africa coach Rassie Erasmus wants his side to channel the frustration of their weekend defeat by New Zealand into the next Test.

items.headline: Solheim Cup captain Nordqvist announces a shock mid-season retirement
items.detail: Team Europe captain Anna Nordqvist has announced she will retire from playing professional golf mid-season, with the FM Championship to be her final LPGA Tour event.

items.headline: Tour Championship to become matchplay from 2028 as McIlroy welcomes the 'big swing'
items.detail: The PGA Tour's season-ending Tour Championship will be played in a matchplay format from 2028, a change Rory McIlroy has welcomed.

items.headline: Late Clark magic holds off McIlroy and Cantlay in a PGA Tour thriller
items.detail: Wyndham Clark blew a big lead before closing out the BMW Championship, holding off Rory McIlroy and Patrick Cantlay for victory.

items.headline: Yamashita equals an LPGA Tour record in a dominant CPKC Women's Open win
items.detail: Miyu Yamashita matched the LPGA Tour's 72-hole scoring record with a dominant victory at the CPKC Women's Open in Edmonton.

items.headline: Jamieson claims a first win in 14 years as Norris stumbles after penalty drama
items.detail: Scott Jamieson won the DP World Tour's Nexo Championship on home soil as overnight leader Shaun Norris fell short after a two-shot penalty.

items.headline: Poulter undecided about his LIV Golf future amid financial concerns
items.detail: Ian Poulter says he is undecided on whether to stay and play on LIV Golf, while hoping the league can continue despite its financial worries.

items.headline: Starc goes past Bumrah to top the Test bowling rankings for the first time
items.detail: Mitchell Starc moved to No. 1 in the ICC men's Test bowling rankings after his match haul helped Australia square the series against Bangladesh.

items.headline: India close in on victory despite Sooriyabandara and Kamindu fifties
items.detail: Sri Lanka ended day four just 16 runs ahead after being asked to follow on in the second Test against India in Galle.

items.headline: Babar set to return for Pakistan at Lord's after a positive training session
items.detail: Pakistan captain Babar Azam is set to return to the side for the second Test against England after a positive training session two days out.

items.headline: Mayfield says the Bucs will 'shock' the world in 2026
items.detail: Baker Mayfield declared that 'everybody' is picking the Tampa Bay Buccaneers to lose, but he believes they will surprise people this season.

items.headline: Cowboys coach on brawls during Saints joint practice: 'I'm in charge of fight club'
items.detail: Brian Schottenheimer joked about the scuffles that broke out during the Dallas Cowboys' joint practice with the New Orleans Saints.

items.headline: Cousins barks at a defender because 'my elbow got hit'
items.detail: Las Vegas Raiders quarterback Kirk Cousins explained a practice dust-up by saying his elbow was hit while wearing a red non-contact jersey.

items.headline: Klay joins the Heat with winning on his mind
items.detail: Veteran Klay Thompson signed with Miami, saying the opportunity to win again at a very high level was 'so attractive' to him.

items.headline: Warriors add Niang and Williams in a series of reported signings
items.detail: Golden State reportedly agreed one-year deals with veteran forward Georges Niang and guard Brandon Williams on Tuesday.

items.headline: DeRozan to sign with the Nuggets on a one-year deal
items.detail: The six-time All-Star, who ranks 16th all-time in points scored, reportedly agreed to a one-year contract with Denver.

items.headline: Glasnow stung by bloop hits early but Ks 7 in return from back injury
items.detail: Tyler Glasnow shook off the rust to strike out seven in his return from a back injury, giving the Dodgers another high-octane arm in their rotation.

items.headline: Brewers rookie Cooper Pratt benched for a lack of hustle
items.detail: Milwaukee sat rookie Cooper Pratt after a missed bunt attempt, with the club stressing players 'gotta be locked in'.

items.headline: Raleigh busts out of a slump with a first career three-homer game
items.detail: Cal Raleigh posted his first career three-home-run game to power the Seattle Mariners past the Philadelphia Phillies.

items.headline: Norris beats Antonelli to victory in the Dutch GP for a second straight win
items.detail: Lando Norris claimed his second successive race victory at Zandvoort, beating Kimi Antonelli to the top step of the podium.

items.headline: Wolff 'not at all' disappointed by Verstappen's new Red Bull deal
items.detail: Mercedes boss Toto Wolff said he is not at all disappointed that Max Verstappen has signed a new contract with Red Bull.

items.headline: Hamilton regrets his frustrated Dutch GP comments
items.detail: Lewis Hamilton took responsibility for his frustrated radio and media comments at the Dutch Grand Prix, admitting it was 'not the best version' of him.

items.headline: Federer rolls back the years in US Open exhibition victories
items.detail: Roger Federer made a victorious return to the US Open courts with two exhibition wins on Tuesday, including against Andy Roddick.

items.headline: Serena and Alcaraz dazzle in mixed doubles before their US Open exit
items.detail: Serena Williams and Carlos Alcaraz thrilled the New York crowd before bowing out of the US Open mixed doubles in the quarter-finals.

items.headline: Fils beats Tiafoe to win Cincinnati and stake a claim as US Open favourite
items.detail: Arthur Fils defeated Frances Tiafoe in a historic all-Black ATP Masters 1000 final to claim the biggest title of his career in Cincinnati.
